acceptanceCriteria: A1: VerificationTier is a strict T0 T1 T2 T3 vocabulary and EvidenceAssurance is a strict SelfDeclared RepositoryVerified ProviderVerified EnterpriseVerified vocabulary; the two dimensions remain independent
A2: A verification requirement can record required tier assurance requirement and traceable policy stage gate references without allowing T3 to imply ProviderVerified or EnterpriseVerified
A3: Existing verification reuse and execution remains fail closed and legacy records do not become green through an implicit tier or assurance mapping
A4: Normal archive lifecycle moves every generated Work Item artifact including implementation approach or leaves no orphan active artifact
A5: Unknown fields invalid tier assurance or contradictory combinations are rejected deterministically and no global project state is introduced
A6: English Japanese and Simplified Chinese documentation explains the orthogonal dimensions and records implementation evidence paths
goal: Introduce VerificationTier and EvidenceAssurance as independent typed governance dimensions and close the generated-artifact archive gap found during self-audit.
intent: Define explicit orthogonal verification truth dimensions before planner and performance work.
outOfScope: Planner policy selection and organization or project policy resolution
CI migration and hard performance targets
sources: User-approved WI-140 to WI-147 verification semantics baseline
